facts.fact: The article says law 045-2009 of 10 November 2009 regulating electronic services and transactions, with its implementing decrees, gives a digital signature the same legal value as a handwritten one.

The article says FasoSign, launched on 15 September 2026, gives effect to law 045-2009 and its implementing decrees, which together give a digital signature the legal value of a handwritten one; it does not name the decrees.
